ti.title: ድንግል ሽዑ ጊዜ
ti.lyrics:
[[chorus]]
ከልቢ ተገፊዑ ሽዑ ጊዜ ኣስትይኒ ክብለኪ
ብወርቃዊ ሳእኒ ዘስተኺ ካብ ማይኪ (2)
[[/chorus]]

ድንግል ሽዑ ጊዜ (2) በርትዐ ሓዘንኪ
ኣብ ልዕሊ መስቀል ክጸዓር ወድኺ

ክሰጉኦ ኣንስቲ ሽዑ ጊዜ ከብድኺ በሊዑኪ
ንፍጡር ሓዚንኪ ዝስተ ዝሃብኪ (2)

ክትሓዝኒ ክትበኽዪ ሽዑ ጊዜ ሓዘን ክውሕጠኪ
መነመን ነበሩ ዘጸናንዑኺ (2)

ti_ro.title: Dngl sh'u gize
ti_ro.lyrics:
[[chorus]]
Bwerqawi sani zestekhi kab mayki (2)
[[/chorus]]

Dngl shu gize (2) berta hazenki
Ab lli mesqel ktsear wedkhi
Kelbi tegefiu shu gize astyni kbleki
Kseguo ansti shu gize kebdkhi beliuki
Nftur hazinki zste zhabki (2)
Tsemaku nabele shu gize kgr wedkhi
Kemey’lu kealo nay welad kebdkhi (2)
Kthazni ktbekhyi shu gize hazen kwhteki
Menemen neberu zetsenanukhi (2)
Ktbekhyi ryuki shu gize rahrihu lbkhi
Ketsenanaki nyohans habeki (2)
